howToUpdate: Edit a row when a programme changes. Use live, bidding or planned. Leave a date blank when it is not on file. Do not add prices, rates, emails or names.
leaseRule: Laurito needs a lease of 7 years or more. That is hurdle 14. A shorter term does not clear.

rows.name: MCC 10 year leasing
rows.block: Houses or flats. No fixed block size is on file.
rows.propertyType: 1 to 5 bed houses or flats. Adapted homes at level 1, 2 or 3 are in demand.
rows.rentBasis: Guaranteed rent, set by zone and bed size, with an extra payment for adapted homes. It moves with inflation each year. Subject to break and maintenance.
rows.leaseFlagText: Break option can cut below the 7 year gate 14 base: Needs evidence on chosen option
rows.manager: Needs evidence. The council is the tenant and furnishes the home.
rows.startLabel: A start month is on the frameworks file. The end date is not.
rows.note: The council handles stamp duty and Land Registry registration. The landlord can be the freeholder, a long leaseholder, or a company holding a headlease longer than 10 years and a day.

rows.name: Glasgow PRSA
rows.block: A pipeline of suitable homes, not completed purchases and not a fixed block.
rows.propertyType: Suitable homes. 5% of the programme must be accessible.
rows.leaseFlagText: Lease length is not on file, so the 7 year rule is Needs evidence.
rows.programme: 250 homes. Indicative share about 25 homes, about 10%, not fixed.
rows.startLabel: Start April 2027. Homes are to be brought on within 12 months of the start.
rows.note: The bid needs a credible pipeline. The indicative share is not a fixed allocation.
